hypothesis: With the original A1 training rows and fixed A2 model recipe, the exact suction-side Strouhal feature meets the same paired gain, grouped uncertainty and latency gates on independent wind-tunnel measurements expressed in the verified original target definition.
baseline: Original five-input ExtraTreesRegressor selected by A1; not claimed globally strongest on external data
candidate_source:
def augment(row):
    return row + [row[0] * row[4] / row[3]]

unchanged_controls.validation_purpose: Historical A1 baseline reproduction only, tolerance 1e-8; no candidate validation screening
unchanged_controls.timing: Five whole-holdout-batch passes per fit, median; candidate includes augmentation and array conversion; seed 22 candidate-first, other seeds baseline-first

primary_metric: Condition-macro paired MAE improvement in dB; same verified target definition, no post-hoc calibration
external_selection_rule: All and only straight-edge BASELINE cases with author-verified suction-side delta*, freestream velocity, angle convention, geometry and predeclared valid acoustic bins; no score-based exclusions, imputation, serrated cases or simulated targets
grouping_status: Unqualified: cluster spectra/nozzle/tripping variants within physical model-condition; pin exact IDs and dependence structure before registration
uncertainty_limit: Within-campaign condition bootstrap, not independent tunnel replication; retain all seeds and variability. Group floor is not a power guarantee.

decisions.data_invalid: STOP_DATA_QUALIFICATION without scientific claim; no model run
decisions.measurement_invalid: INVALID; retain reservation after launch; no automatic retry
decisions.valid_failed_gate: STOP fixed-feature external-transfer route; no tuning, masks, target scale, data or model rescue
decisions.valid_all_gates_passed: CONTINUE limited to the preregistered external conditions; no automatic deployment

next_gate: Resolve source definitions, quality and intended-use permission; implement and synthetically validate external adapter; freeze full execution manifest; seek separate explicit user approval
